entries.content_osis: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7129"/><title type="x-s2">PSALM 147</title> <title type="x-s3"><reference osisRef="Ps.147.1-Ps.147.20">Psa 147:1-20</reference>. This and the remaining Psalms have been represented as specially designed to celebrate the rebuilding of Jerusalem (compare <reference osisRef="Neh.6.16">Ne 6:16</reference>; <reference osisRef="Neh.12.27">12:27</reference>). They all open and close with the stirring call for praise. This mighty ruler and benefactor of heaven and earth is such especially to His chosen people, to whom alone (<reference osisRef="Deut.4.32-Deut.4.34">De 4:32-34</reference>) He has made known His will, while others have been left in darkness. Therefore unite in the great hallelujah. <chapter eID="Ps.147"/>
